name: Gumroad
label: Gumroad — Gumroad OAuth API v2
description: Official Gumroad OAuth API v2. Docs: https://app.gumroad.com/api. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. Ping/webhooks land on BPMN message events — same node, no Gumroad Trigger sibling.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Gumroad. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: sale_list | product_list | subscriber_list | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: product_id
schema.description: Gumroad product id for subscriber_list (from product_list). Required on INPUT or configurationParameters when operation is subscriber_list.

schema.label: After date
schema.description: sale_list after (YYYY-MM-DD) — sales on or after this date. Example: 2026-01-01.

schema.label: Before date
schema.description: sale_list before (YYYY-MM-DD) — sales on or before this date.

schema.label: Buyer email
schema.description: sale_list / subscriber_list email filter. Example: ada@example.com. PII.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: sale_list | product_list | subscriber_list | trigger. Default sale_list. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Gumroad OAuth access token. Query `access_token` still works; official preferred is Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Default product id
configurationParameters.description: Default Gumroad product id for subscriber_list when INPUT omits product_id. Obtain from product_list.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
